question: The online task publishing and management system shall allow users to register and maintain personal information, including avatars and contact details. Users shall be able to publish tasks in the system, specifying the task title, description, budget, and deadline, and assigning the task to a specific category, city, or location. Other users shall be able to respond to published tasks, providing quotes and additional comments. After the task publisher selects an executor, both parties shall be able to communicate through messages within the system, exchange relevant files, and track task progress. Upon task completion, the publisher shall be able to evaluate the executor and provide ratings. The system shall also support managing basic user statistics, such as the number of completed tasks and failed tasks, to help other users better understand the reliability of executors. By associating cities, locations, categories, and tasks, the system shall effectively help users match suitable tasks with executors, improving task completion efficiency.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0224
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_users_username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_users_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `user_statistics` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `completed_tasks` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `failed_tasks` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `average_rating` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_ratings` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_statistics_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `categories` (
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`category_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_categories_category_name` (`category_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `cities` (
  `city_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `city_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `province` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`city_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_cities_city_name` (`city_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `locations` (
  `location_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `city_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `location_name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `address_detail` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `latitude` decimal(10,7) DEFAULT NULL,
  `longitude` decimal(10,7) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`location_id`),
  KEY `locations_ibfk_1` (`city_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `locations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`city_id`) REFERENCES `cities` (`city_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `tasks` (
  `task_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `publisher_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `executor_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `city_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `budget` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `deadline` datetime NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`task_id`),
  KEY `tasks_ibfk_1` (`publisher_id`),
  KEY `tasks_ibfk_2` (`executor_id`),
  KEY `tasks_ibfk_3` (`category_id`),
  KEY `tasks_ibfk_4` (`city_id`),
  KEY `tasks_ibfk_5` (`location_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tasks_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`publisher_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tasks_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`executor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tasks_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`category_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tasks_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`city_id`) REFERENCES `cities` (`city_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `tasks_ibfk_5` FOREIGN KEY (`location_id`) REFERENCES `locations` (`location_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `task_responses` (
  `response_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `responder_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `quote_amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `comment` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`response_id`),
  KEY `task_responses_ibfk_1` (`task_id`),
  KEY `task_responses_ibfk_2` (`responder_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `task_responses_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `task_responses_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`responder_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `messages` (
  `message_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `sender_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `receiver_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `message_text` text NOT NULL,
  `sent_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `is_read` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`message_id`),
  KEY `messages_ibfk_1` (`task_id`),
  KEY `messages_ibfk_2` (`sender_id`),
  KEY `messages_ibfk_3` (`receiver_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `messages_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `messages_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`sender_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `messages_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`receiver_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `task_files` (
  `file_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `uploader_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_url` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_size` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `uploaded_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`file_id`),
  KEY `task_files_ibfk_1` (`task_id`),
  KEY `task_files_ibfk_2` (`uploader_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `task_files_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `task_files_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`uploader_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `task_progress` (
  `progress_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `progress_status` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `progress_note` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `progress_percent` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`progress_id`),
  KEY `task_progress_ibfk_1` (`task_id`),
  KEY `task_progress_ibfk_2` (`updated_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `task_progress_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `task_progress_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`updated_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `task_evaluations` (
  `evaluation_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `evaluator_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `executor_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `rating` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `comment` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`evaluation_id`),
  KEY `task_evaluations_ibfk_1` (`task_id`),
  KEY `task_evaluations_ibfk_2` (`evaluator_id`),
  KEY `task_evaluations_ibfk_3` (`executor_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `task_evaluations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `task_evaluations_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`evaluator_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `task_evaluations_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`executor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
